mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.permission_code, f.name, f.icon, f.menu_sort, f.url FROM cm_function f WHERE f.function_source = 'p4' AND f.function_type = 1 AND f.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.menu_sort

SELECT DISTINCT f.permission_code FROM cm_user_role ur INNER JOIN cm_role_function rf ON rf.role_id = ur.role_id AND rf.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN cm_function f ON f.id = rf.function_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.permission_code
SELECT f.permission_code FROM cm_function f WHERE f.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.permission_code
